name: escalate_approval
description: escalate_approval: Escalate a pending approval to a skip-level approver. Only succeeds if the original SLA has been breached — returns an error if the SLA has not yet been breached. Sets a new 48-hour SLA window on the escalation.

request_id.description: The request ID to escalate (e.g. REQ-SW-048271).

escalate_to_employee_id.description: The skip-level approver's employee ID (e.g. EMP031482).
